catalog.name: browser-bug-reproduction
catalog.description: Reproduce a reported web UI failure in an authorized test environment and produce a minimal evidence pack with expected and observed behavior. Use for browser reproduction, not code review, implementation, or production incident changes.

catalog.name: calendar-coordination
catalog.description: Find meeting times or create, reschedule, and cancel scoped calendar events while preserving recurrence and invitations. Use for calendar coordination, not a general daily briefing or inbox review.

catalog.name: daily-briefing
catalog.description: Build a source-linked daily brief from specified mail, calendar, task, or project sources, prioritizing deadlines and decisions with explicit coverage. Use for a bounded cross-source briefing, not an account-wide scan, message send, or recurring watch setup.

catalog.name: expense-reconciliation
catalog.description: Reconcile a specified expense set with receipts and a supplied policy, preserving currencies, refunds, and unresolved matches. Use for a review ledger or authorized reconciliation updates, not payment, tax advice, or general spreadsheet editing.

catalog.name: github-review
catalog.description: Review a specified GitHub pull request at its current head, inspect the diff and surrounding context, and prepare actionable findings with check status. Use for PR review; reviewing does not authorize comments, approval, pushes, or merging.

catalog.name: gmail-draft-reply
catalog.description: Compose, save, revise, or send a scoped Gmail reply as requested, preserving its thread, recipients, sender identity, and attachments. Use for message composition and reply completion, not inbox classification or labeling.

catalog.name: gmail-triage
catalog.description: Review a bounded Gmail inbox or search result, identify actionable messages, and apply explicitly requested organization. Use for mail triage and labeling; summarizing mail does not authorize sending, deleting, or changing inbox settings.

catalog.name: google-docs-update
catalog.description: Make a bounded Google Docs content or formatting change in the correct tab and section, preserving unrelated material and verifying the saved revision. Use for document edits, not Sheets cells, document sharing, or exporting files.

catalog.name: google-sheets-update
catalog.description: Update or append specified Google Sheets cells or rows through available document tools or an authorized browser, preserving formulas and checking saved results. Use for bounded sheet data edits, not workbook redesign or broad data analysis.

catalog.name: product-shortlist
catalog.description: Compare current product or used-item offers in exact configurations using total cost, condition, and buyer constraints. Use for shopping research and listing comparison; it does not contact sellers, bid, reserve, or purchase.

catalog.name: recurring-monitor
catalog.description: Set up or check a recurring watch with clear alert rules, saved observations, and an available host scheduler. Use for ongoing monitoring, not a one-time lookup.

catalog.name: session-to-skill
catalog.description: Turn an authorized session or demonstration into a sanitized, reusable Agent Skills draft with explicit evidence limits and verification criteria. Use for workflow capture and skill authoring, not bulk export of personal histories or automatic publication.

catalog.name: travel-reservation
catalog.description: Prepare or complete an explicitly requested travel booking, change, or cancellation while tracking exact travelers, total price, terms, payment, and reservation status. Use for reservation lifecycle work, not a generic shopping shortlist.

catalog.name: web-form-update
catalog.description: Change specified profile, settings, or form values and verify persistence, including autosave and validation behavior. Use for bounded record edits; purchases, reservations, and outgoing messages need their specific workflow.

catalog.name: web-research
catalog.description: Answer current public-web questions or analyze supplied public-source bundles using direct evidence, dates, and explicit uncertainty. Use for research and conflicting-source synthesis; exact shopping offers and account operations have separate workflows.

catalog.name: web-task-execution
catalog.description: Operate a requested website task or recover browser access using the correct account and tab context, then verify the result. Use for general browser handling when a more specific workflow does not fit; public-source research alone is excluded.
